spec.description:
Thermotec Rockwool Pipe
Insulation is a heavy-duty, pre-formed mineral wool pipe lagging engineered for
industrial and commercial pipework carrying high-temperature fluids and steam at
continuous temperatures up to 650°C. Manufactured from non-combustible volcanic
rock fibres with a nominal density of 115 to 140 kg/m³, it is factory-laminated
with a reinforced aluminium foil facing to act as a vapour barrier and protect
against moisture ingress. It delivers exceptional thermal insulation and
acoustic noise attenuation on steam lines, boilers, high-pressure hot water, and
exhaust systems.
features:
High-density pre-formed stone wool pipe
sections (nominal 115 to 140 kg/m³)

Extreme continuous service temperature up
to 650°C (outer foil limit 80°C - 100°C)

Non-combustible stone wool substrate
complying with AS 1530.1 and BS 476 Part 4

Factory-applied reinforced
aluminium foil facing provides a tough vapour barrier

Specifically engineered
for high-pressure steam pipes, boilers, and industrial processes

Provides
substantial acoustic noise dampening of fluid rush and turbulent knocking
Water-repellent, rot-proof, and resistant to fungal and bacterial growth

Chemically inert and will not promote stress corrosion cracking on copper or
stainless steel

Pre-slit one-meter hinged sections allow rapid snap-on
installation

Complies with Australian commercial and industrial insulation
specifications

install:
Ensure pipe surface is cool, dry, clean, and
rust-treated before lagging

Open the pre-slit hinged 1m Rockwool section and
snap over the pipe

Align longitudinal seams along the least visible side
(typically top or back)

Peel release paper from the factory self-adhesive
foil overlap (or tape with reinforced foil tape)

Smooth down the foil lap
firmly with a squeegee to establish an airtight vapour seal

Butt
consecutive 1m sections tightly together and seal circumferential joints
with 72mm reinforced foil tape

Secure lagging with stainless steel or
aluminium bands or tie wire at 300mm to 400mm centres for high-temperature
pipework

Mitre cut sections neatly around elbows, valves, and tees, sealing
all cut edges with foil tape
selection_checklist:
Confirm pipe
operating temperature exceeds 100°C (up to 650°C continuous)

Measure outside
diameter of pipe to match internal diameter of Rockwool section

Select wall
thickness (25mm, 38mm, or 50mm) based on required surface touch temperature and
energy limits

Order matching 72mm reinforced aluminium foil tape and metal
banding straps
accessories: Stainless steel or aluminium pipe banding straps
limitations:
Outer aluminium foil
facing must not exceed 80°C - 100°C (insulation wall thickness must be
calculated to keep surface temperature within limits)

Outdoor installations
exposed to weather require metal cladding or UV-resistant VentureClad
jacketing

Handle with gloves and dust mask during cutting to avoid mechanical
fiber irritation

heat loss from

use_cases:
Thermal insulation on commercial and
industrial high-pressure steam pipes operating up to 650°C

Lagging boiler
feed lines, turbines, and hot water manifold pipework to prevent worker burn
injuries

Acoustic and thermal insulation on high-temperature generator and
industrial exhaust lines
not_for:
Chilled water pipes without secondary
vapor barriers where condensation could saturate open joints

Direct burial in
soil without protective culvert casing

Standard residential domestic hot
water lines where flexible foam is more cost effective
retrieval.rag_summary:
Thermotec Rockwool Pipe Insulation is a heavy-duty, foil-faced pre-formed stone
wool pipe lagging designed for high-temperature commercial and industrial
pipework operating continuously up to 650°C. Engineered from dense volcanic rock
fibers (115 to 140 kg/m³) and pre-split into 1-meter hinged sections, it
provides exceptional heat conservation and acoustic sound attenuation on steam
lines, boilers, and industrial exhaust manifolds. Certified non-combustible to
AS 1530.1 with early fire hazard indices of 0,0,0,0-1 to AS 1530.3, it delivers
reliable passive fire protection and thermal containment.
